name: m11-w6
note: Ablations A3 (depth-0) and A5 (decision layer off) against the A2 reference rows already recorded in W5, joined on query_id. A4 (no-KG), A6 (KG raw) and A7 (role filter off) are retired: the graph was built 3 times and traversed 0 times in 24 recorded runs, so those arms compared the system with itself. The query list is all **18** I5 instances rather than the 15 the plan assumed, so no instance is excluded and the join with W5's A2 rows is exact. 18 x 2 = 36 runs.

arms.name: depth0
arms.note: A3: recursion removed at the route (no /sub_task), every other knob equal to the A2 reference.

arms.name: gate-off
arms.note: A5: decision layer off. No JEV call and no gate key at all, so the claim pass still runs but never rejects.
